Its Jacobian gives singular line, and the q² X-fiber over each nonscalar admissible Y plus Y=0 gives exact polynomial counts. Independently enumerated exact GF2,GF3,GF4,GF5 literal products and component counts; finite cases do not prove all characteristics.

value.rationale: PASS — The Jordan plane is a canonical noncommutative quadratic algebra. The characteristic-two jump already at the smallest nontrivial representation dimension gives a natural modular counterpoint to characteristic-zero equidimensional representation geometry, with exact singular locus and rational-point counts. final_claim: For every field, the reduced labelled 2×2 Jordan-plane representation variety [X,Y]=Y² has two 4D geometric components in odd characteristic and 4D+5D components in characteristic two; exact finite-field point counts are 2q⁴−q² (odd) and q⁵+q⁴−q³ (even), with the stated char-2 singular line and intersections.
limitations: Only reduced labelled 2x2 matrix-pair varieties, not nonreduced schemes, higher ranks, or conjugacy moduli.
